critical_code_review_comments: index.html contains a page-loader spinner + a script that hides #root. Since /inicio.html is a static HTML with no React root, this is only used as a redirect shim, which is fine, but note the meta refresh + JS redirect duplication (harmless).

Some anchors in top-nav and footer use href='#' as placeholders. Not a bug per spec (only /inicio.html and /inscricao are required), but consider disabling styles or adding aria-disabled until real routes exist.
